parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with mechanism of action classified as a sequestering agent. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno. Filter drug_mechanism.action_type to 'SEQUESTERING AGENT'. Join target_dictionary on drug_mechanism.tid to retrieve target identifiers and names. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), and target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name). Sort rows by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name.
